text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was so close! Man, this really pisses me 
off!
choice_data_list: Let's finish in 1st place next time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What kind of low-standard nonsense are you 
talking about?! I was aiming for 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Besides, my results reflect directly on 
your competence, so you gotta aim higher! 
Right!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hurry home and hold a 
debrief! 'Cause next time, we're 
definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right! On the name of the "White 
Lightning," I'm definitely gonna win next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Moping around is a waste of time! Let's 
get going to training right now!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I am never, ever gonna let myself feel 
this frustrated again!
